reviews.review_text:
James Nguyen
3 contributions
0
Amazing place on the train street
May 2025 • Friends
Heard from the locals that you can watch the trains on this street. There were a lot of cafes on the street that let you sit right next to the rail and watch the train. While we were walking on this street, there was this girl who seemed to be the owner, she asked me whether I wanted to watch the train and took me to this cafe. The experience was amazing, we got there at 4 pm, there was an amazing sunset right when we got there, and we stayed until 10 pm. We ordered a coconut coffee, a cocktail, a smoothie, few bottles of beer, and some food like fried noodles, pho, banh mi. It was all really delicious and cheap too. The owners were friendly and funny, they even gave us some snacks and fruit without charging us anything. The little girl talked to us and gave many recommendations on where to go in Hanoi, she also took a picture of us with a polaroid camera and gave us the picture. There was this big speaker that had mics and we sang karaoke there. The train experience was so thrilling, we were literally right next to the train when it passed by, it was kinda scary but also so cool. This place was honestly the most memorable place for me in Hanoi. If I ever come back to Hanoi, I will definitely come by again.
